snippet.title: Instant Sports 2 - Available Now on Switch and PlayStation 5!
snippet.description:
This summer, gather your friends and jump into 10 sports in Instant Sports 2, available now on PS5 and Nintendo Switch! Physical editions will be available in September.

Whether you're a sports fanatic or just looking for a good time, Instant Sports 2 has 10 unique events designed for maximum fun. Challenge your friends, beat your personal bests, and customize your character with hundreds of options. 🎾🏓🛹
